character.name: 随军伙夫 / army cook
character.desc: Stocky cheerful middle-aged Chinese man, friendly black moustache and short goatee, cream cook headwrap, brown rolled-sleeve tunic, large cream stained apron, dark trousers, cloth shoes. Holds long wooden soup ladle in right hand and small dark iron cooking pot in left. Recognizable round apron silhouette.
character.special: guard and hot soup sequence, raise round iron pot as shield and stir with wooden ladle then offer steaming bowl; steam small and connected

visual_review: Selected after full-source visual inspection; exported idle, move, attack, special and independent head subsequently inspected. All body frames independently drawn; hit reuses reviewed idle poses.
